$comment: Publisher records that reach no plugin at all, each with the reason it is expected to. Judged by tools/selftest/publishers.mjs (gap 6), and read by one other program: bot/recheck-publishers.mjs, the daily re-check, which drops a withdrawn record's declaration in the same unattended commit as the withdrawal. That is why this file is under state/ and not tools/selftest/: it is a record a run writes, not a rule a run judges by, and inside TRUST-31's hashed set every such commit would put the bot into shadow. Not under publishers/, where every *.json is loaded as a publisher record. A record in publishers/ whose logins — `owner` and every `covers` entry — own no plugins/*/plugin.json `source.repo`, listed or unlisted, FAILS the suite unless it is declared here: that is the state publishers/KnlCE.json sat in for three days in August 2026, reviewed, correct, and reaching nothing, with every check green. A DECLARATION THAT MATCHES NOTHING FAILS: an entry naming a file that is not a publisher record the loader returns is refused, which is what stops this file collecting excuses for records nobody can see — so when the daily re-check withdraws an expired record, its declaration goes in the same change. Each entry is {record, reason} and nothing else; `record` is the path exactly as the loader reports it, `reason` says why no listing is expected and what would end that. TWO STATES ARE REPORTED AND NEVER REFUSED, and the reason is the same for both: this suite is the fifth check the publish path runs and a check the moderation commit job runs, so a failure here would refuse a bot commit. A record whose only listings are unlisted needs no entry — a takedown sets `unlisted: true`, and it must never be refused for leaving a badge with nothing to stand beside. A declared record that now reaches a listed listing prints a note asking for the entry to be deleted — the publication that made it reach one ran this suite, and refusing it would refuse the very listing the declaration was waiting for.

declarations.reason: Astra team. His one plugin, astra-chess, is published from KNICE-TECH/astra-chess and has been frozen unlisted since 2026-09-12, because KNICE-TECH is the organisation's login from before its rename to MINICE-AI and GitHub frees a renamed login for anybody to register. The record covers MINICE-AI, where no listing exists yet, and must never be made to reach the frozen listing by covering KNICE-TECH (the freed-login test in tools/selftest/publishers.mjs). It reaches a listing when astra-chess is published from MINICE-AI/astra-chess; delete this entry then.
